**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 22.1)**

Section 22.1 was at the playbook walk-away position — unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems — and also conflicted with § 22.2, which already prohibits direct system access and puts audit cost on Vendor unless underpayment exceeds 5%.

The validated redline replaces § 22.1 with the preferred position: once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, an independent auditor at Vendor's cost bound by confidentiality, off-site review of records we provide, and no direct or remote system access. Sections 22.2 and 22.3 are left untouched since they already carry the cost-shift threshold and confidentiality protections; the comment offers 15 days' notice as a fallback.
